terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && source ../.venv/bin/activate && export WEBUI_SECRET_KEY="$(cat .webui_secret_key 2>/dev/null || (head -c24 /dev/urandom | base64 > .webui_secret_key && cat .webui_secret_key))" && export CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN="http://localhost:5173;http://localhost:8080" && exec uvicorn open_webui.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --forwarded-allow-ips "*" --reload
